verdict.rationale: Portkey publishes an API reference for its Inference API. It has a documented REST base URL (`https://api.portkey.ai/v1`), and gateway features are switched on via Portkey-specific headers, so the core product can be driven programmatically through one unified API. Missing for 10: documented management/admin API endpoints (configs, logs, keys, budgets), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`
By changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers, you can quickly integrate Portkey’s features into your existing setup.
Access AWS, Azure, Vertex AI, and on-prem solutions like Nvidia Triton, vLLM, and Ollama through a single, unified Portkey API.
